summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Mohr Company Nav ETF (CNAV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation by tactically investing in large-cap companies across various US market sectors. Stock selection is based on price movements within industries of the S&P 500 index. CNAV was launched on Oct 1, 2024 and is issued by Mohr Funds.

holdings.infoBox: CNAV is an equity ETF with a total of 30 individual holdings. The top holdings are Western Digital stock at 4.91%, Dell Technologies at 4.79%, CrowdStrike Holdings at 4.28%, Sandisk at 4.22%, and Micron Technology at 4.06%.
